name: PICNIC_1_KM_LEFT_LANE_BLUE_LONG

service_picnic_area.desc: Picnic area symbol (tree with picnic table), 800x800 box; drawn 695x708 ink centred in its 800x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

notes: 3350x1800 R240; blue 50 / white 50. Symbol 260 | 800; right chain 460 | 400 E (numeral) | 360 | 320 E | 260 = 1800, km 340 Emod on the 860 baseline. Bottom: = | 800 | 214 | 389 (dashed numeral box) | 200 | 700 | = group centred; the numeral varies (1 illustrated) and is centred in its 389 slot; '1 km' is one runs line starting at the slot (523.5 + 800 + 214 = 1537.5). LEFT LANE 392 | 1101 | 240 | 1225 | 392. Service symbols: the drawing dimensions the symbol boxes (service_picnic_area 800x800 at 523.5,260); the pictograms do not fill them, so each element box is the pictogram's ink extent measured from the drawing, centred in the dimensioned box (nominal_box).
